[[Brightclaw]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Chkkr Brightclaw]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Melandru's Hope]].

==Stats==
:[[Lightning damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]])
:Halves casting time of [[Restoration Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge time of [[Restoration Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated. Inscription and wand wrapping would result in HCT and HSR of [[Spawning Power]] instead of [[Restoration Magic]].

==Unique counterparts==
The [[Restoration Magic]] version of [[Droknar's Scepter]] has nearly identical stats to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires Restoration Magic.

==Notes==
*This item is popular as both [[Gertrud]] and [[Telamon]], who offer 20/20 wands and foci, do not offer a Restoration wand.
*This item uses the [[Spawning Wand (claw)|Spawning Wand]] skin, [[dye]]d silver.
